# DJ Orestis

> Greek DJ based in Brussels, playing weddings, corporate events and private parties across Belgium and Europe. Trained in the nightlife of Mykonos, resident DJ at Papillon Schuman. More than ten years of events.

Bookings cover Belgium and travel across Europe. Sound and lighting can be supplied with the booking, and live musicians and singers can be arranged alongside the DJ set, from Belgium or from Greece.

Announcements at events are made in English and Greek, and in Bulgarian. Written enquiries are also welcome in French and Dutch.

The site is published in English, French, Dutch and Greek; the English pages are listed here and each one links to its translations.

## Services
- [Corporate event DJ in Brussels](https://djorestis.com/corporate-event-dj-brussels/): Corporate event DJ in Brussels for receptions, staff parties and launches. Clients include Freshfields and BCG. Sound and lighting available.
- [Wedding DJ in Brussels & Belgium](https://djorestis.com/wedding-dj-brussels/): Wedding DJ in Brussels and across Belgium for Greek, international and mixed weddings. Tailored playlists from ceremony to last dance, sound and light included.
- [Greek DJ in Brussels](https://djorestis.com/greek-dj-brussels/): Greek DJ in Brussels: authentic Greek nights for communities and private parties. Resident at Papillon Schuman and host of the Greek Food Festival.
- [Balkan & Bulgarian DJ in Brussels](https://djorestis.com/balkan-dj-brussels/): Balkan and Bulgarian DJ in Brussels: pop-folk, chalga, Greek laika and international sets, with hosting in Bulgarian. Across Belgium.
- [Party DJ in Brussels](https://djorestis.com/party-dj-brussels/): Private party DJ in Brussels for birthdays, anniversaries and celebrations. Open-format: electronic, Afro, Latin, RnB and Greek. Sound and light available.
- [Full-package event solutions](https://djorestis.com/full-package/): One partner for the whole event: DJ, sound and lighting for up to 500 guests, plus photography and video. One contact, one setup, one invoice.
- [Resident DJ for restaurants & bars](https://djorestis.com/restaurant-dj-brussels/): A resident DJ for your restaurant or bar in Brussels. Themed nights that fill quiet weekdays and lift bar revenue. Four years at Papillon Schuman.
- [Greek DJ across Europe](https://djorestis.com/greek-dj-europe/): A Mykonos-trained Greek DJ for destination events across Europe: weddings, corporate evenings and Greek parties, from Brussels to the islands.

## About and contact
- [About DJ Orestis](https://djorestis.com/about/): Three years in Mykonos nightlife, then Brussels: resident DJ at Papillon Schuman, weddings and corporate events across Europe for over ten years.
- [Services](https://djorestis.com/services/): DJ services in Brussels: corporate events, weddings, baptisms, Greek nights and private parties, with full sound, light, photo and video if you need it.
- [Six music worlds, one DJ](https://djorestis.com/music/): The six music worlds DJ Orestis mixes: Greek, Balkan, electronic, Afro, Latin and RnB, and how a set is built for a wedding or a corporate room.
- [Past events & residencies](https://djorestis.com/events/): Where DJ Orestis has played: the Papillon Schuman residency, the Brussels Greek Food Festival, corporate evenings, and Greek nights across Europe.
- [Request a quote](https://djorestis.com/contact/): Book DJ Orestis for a wedding, corporate event or party in Brussels, Belgium or across Europe. Send the form and receive a personalised proposal.
